actions.name: Decaying Touch
actions.description: Costs 1 Investiture. Attack +6 vs. Spiritual, reach 5 ft., one target. Graze: 13 (3d8) spirit damage. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) spirit damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Agility test or their armor rusts and decays, permanently decreasing its deflect value by 1. Armor damaged in this way can be repaired with proper materials as a downtime activity.

actions.name: Burst of Flame
actions.description: Costs 2 Investiture. The Dustbringer emits a burst of fire that deals 4 (1d8) energy damage to each character within 10 feet of them and sets unattended objects in that area ablaze. Additionally, the Dustbringer can spend 1 focus or more to shower sparks onto that many enemies within 30 feet of them; each target must succeed on a DC 14 Agility test or lose one focus on their next turn.

actions.name: Eroding Escape
actions.description: Costs 1 Investiture. The Dustbringer targets themself or an ally in reach, ending one condition on them that is either applying the Immobilized condition, the Restrained condition, or a disadvantage on a physical test.

actions.name: Regenerate
actions.description: Costs 1 Investiture. The Dustbringer recovers 5 (1d6 + 2) health. They can use this free action even while Unconscious or otherwise prevented from using actions.

actions.name: Skate
actions.description: Costs 2 Focus. The Dustbringer moves up to their movement rate in a straight line.

strikes.name: Sidesword
strikes.on-hit: The Dustbringer can spend 1 focus to use the Disengage action as a free action.
strikes.description: Attack +6, reach 5 ft., one target. Graze: 3 (1d6) keen damage. Hit: 9 (1d6 + 6) keen damage, and the Dustbringer can spend 1 focus to use the Disengage action as a free action.

strikes.name: Shortbow
strikes.description: Attack +6, range 80/320 ft., one target. Graze: 3 (1d6) keen damage. Hit: 9 (1d6 + 6) keen damage.
